summary.text: Jim Haddock is the Democratic incumbent, in office since December 1, 2022, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 118, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jim Haddock, listed by Ballotpedia as James Haddock, assumed office on December 1, 2022.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignments as Game & Fisheries, Gaming Oversight, and Labor & Industry, where he was subcommittee chair on Workers Compensation and Worker Protection.
